landing.sectionsTitle: Built for clarity, discipline, and long-term performance
landing.soundFamiliarSubtitle: If any of this sounds like your trading, you're not alone. And you're not broken — you just need a system that holds you accountable.
landing.persona1Body: You take a loss. You're convinced the market owes you. You double your size. The next loss wipes the week.
landing.persona2Body: You wrote your trading plan. You read it every morning. You break it by Tuesday afternoon and don't even notice.
landing.persona3Body: You blow your daily loss limit on a Tuesday. You didn't even know how close you were. The challenge is over before you knew it started.
landing.step1Body: Auto-sync your live trades from any MetaTrader 5 broker — prop firm or personal account.
landing.step2Body: Set entry criteria, max risk per trade, daily loss limits, and session restrictions.
landing.step3Body: Real-time drawdown tracking, rule validation, and behavioral pattern detection.
landing.leadMagnetSubtitle: The exact 12-point checklist disciplined prop traders use before every entry. Drop your email — we'll send the PDF.
landing.leadMagnetSuccess: Check your email — the checklist is on its way.
landing.calcSubtitle: Plug in your account size, drawdown %, and profit target. We'll show you exactly what you need to do to pass.

landing.notForYouTitle: TradifyApp is not for you if…
landing.notForYouItem1: You want signals, alerts or trade ideas — we don't tell you what to trade.
landing.notForYouItem2: You want a copy-trading or auto-execution bot — we never touch your trades.
landing.notForYouItem3: You're not willing to write your own rules — we enforce yours, not ours.

about.title: About TradifyApp
about.subtitle: Built by a prop trader who lost too many challenges to undisciplined trading.
about.missionBody: Help traders enforce the rules they already wrote — so the only thing standing between them and a funded account is the market, not themselves.
about.value1Body: We don't tell you what to trade. We help you stick to what you already decided.
about.value2Body: We never auto-execute, never share your trades. You stay in full control.
about.value3Body: Every feature was born from a real losing trade or a real prop challenge fail.
